brandBrain.title: Brand Brain
brandBrain.subtitle: Every AI generation (analysis, strategy, copywriting) draws on this identity and on what Campaign-ai has learned — the more complete they are, the more consistent the results are with your brand.
brandBrain.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG — stored permanently.
brandBrain.visionPlaceholder: Where you want to take your market
brandBrain.rulesHint: Non-negotiable constraints — applied to every generation, and blocked by code on manual edits when forbidden terms are defined.
brandBrain.insightsHint: Enriched automatically (publications, manual edits, Optimizer) — every piece of knowledge shows why Campaign-ai believes it.
brandBrain.insightsEmpty: No learning yet — memory fills in after your first campaign is published or edited.

brandBrain.contradictionsHint: Two conflicting pieces of knowledge are never injected together in a prompt until resolved.
